text: The internet named a polar ship Boaty McBoatface. In twenty sixteen, a science agency asked the public to name a new ship. Boaty McBoatface won with over one hundred twenty four thousand votes. The agency said no. The ship became RRS Sir David Attenborough. The man who suggested Boaty voted for Attenborough too. Boaty got a consolation prize: a small submarine. Should they have listened?
